articles.title: What Does QUALCOMM (QCOM) Winning A Nationwide 5G Buildout Mean For Investors?
articles.description: QUALCOMM (NasdaqGS:QCOM) and SpaceX have agreed a multiyear partnership to power the new Starlink Mobile nationwide 5G network. The project uses Qualcomm 5G infrastructure technology at national scale, taking the chip designer beyond its traditional smartphone-focused business. Starlink Mobile aims to offer a satellite-backed 5G service across the U.S., creating a new competitor to existing wireless carriers. This Starlink Mobile 5G infrastructure deal with SpaceX is a big swing for Qualcomm...
